card.writes: It pushes down tokens like tobacco and nicotine, so the model reads the piece as a drug name, not as tobacco or caffeine.
card.plain: It spots the first syllable of drug names like methotrexate or tobramycin, so the model doesn't mistake them for tobacco words.
